[TPS_SWCT_01346] Asynchronous operation invocation ⌈Asynchronous invoca- tion is a bit more complex because it is necessary to specify how to respond to a notification about the completion of the corresponding operation. This is done using the generic RTEEvent mechanism: the notification about an asynchronously executed operation having completed is implemented as an Asyn- chronousServerCallReturnsEvent. Therefore, if an AsynchronousServerCallReturnsEvent is raised the RTE can either trigger the execution of a specific RunnableEntity or the AtomicSwCom- ponentType can implement a WaitPoint that blocks the execution of the calling emplate
